explanation: OEIS A167918 (a(n) = smallest k > n with f(n,k) = (p_k + p_{k+1})/(p_n + p_{n+1}) an integer ≥ 2): '(1) It is conjectured that sequence is infinite', i.e. a(n) is defined for every n. Since k > n gives S(k) > S(n), any multiple is ≥ 2·S(n), so 'integer ≥ 2' is just S(n) | S(k). The formal statement asks for k > n with S(n) | S(k), for every n > 0. Faithful.
